description: Metadata extracted from a native PDF document.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag declared in the PDF catalogue (e.g. 'lt', 'en-US')

encryptFilter.description: Name of the encryption filter if the document is encrypted, otherwise null

isLinearized.description: True if the PDF is linearized (optimized for fast web viewing)

isAcroFormPresent.description: True if the document contains an AcroForm (interactive form fields)

isXfaPresent.description: True if the document contains an XFA form

isCollectionPresent.description: True if the document is a PDF Portfolio / Collection

isSignaturesPresent.description: True if the document declares at least one signature field

title.description: Document title from the PDF info dictionary

author.description: Author field from the PDF info dictionary

subject.description: Subject field from the PDF info dictionary

keywords.description: Keywords field from the PDF info dictionary

creator.description: Application that originally created the document (e.g. 'Microsoft® Word 2016')

producer.description: Application that produced or last modified the PDF file

sloppyRedactions.description: Text items that are visually covered by an opaque black or red annotation but remain in the content stream
